# APIbase Integrator

> AI payment for merchants. A merchant gets its own MCP storefront; a buyer's agent gets a quote and pays in USDC (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) straight to the merchant wallet. Fee: {{INTEGRATOR_FEE_PCT}}. Merchants connected: {{MERCHANTS_COUNT}}.

- [Overview](https://apibase.pro/integrator): the offer, four ways to add a link, fee, security, FAQ (send Accept: text/markdown for Markdown)
- [Agent guide](https://apibase.pro/integrator/agent-guide): step-by-step connection for a merchant's agent, with error codes
- [Integrator guide](https://apibase.pro/integrator/docs): the full merchant reference (registration, catalog, quotes, orders, webhooks, subscriptions)
- [For buyers](https://apibase.pro/integrator/buyers): limits, quotes, what is and is not guaranteed
- [Several agents, one budget](https://apibase.pro/integrator/buyers): fund one wallet per agent; the server sees wallets, not agents
- [Before you send a payment](https://apibase.pro/integrator/agent-guide): persist the payment identifier and signed payload first; re-send, never re-sign
- [Why Base and Tempo](https://apibase.pro/integrator/why-base-tempo): the two payment rails
- [Wallet help](https://apibase.pro/integrator/wallet): getting a wallet with USDC; APIbase issues none
- [Shopify](https://apibase.pro/integrator/platforms/shopify)
- [WooCommerce](https://apibase.pro/integrator/platforms/woocommerce)
- [Tilda](https://apibase.pro/integrator/platforms/tilda)
- [Wix](https://apibase.pro/integrator/platforms/wix)
- [Custom site](https://apibase.pro/integrator/platforms/custom)
- [Connect form (humans)](https://apibase.pro/integrator/connect)
- [Demo shop](https://apibase.pro/m/apibase-demo)
- [Legal documents](https://apibase.pro/legal/index.json)
- [Check a connection](https://apibase.pro/integrator/check/apibase-demo)
